newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups Porsche target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups Porsche target.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it raised its mid-1998 price target for shares in sports car maker Porsche AG to 3,000 marks from 2,000 and said it expected its old target to be met by mid 1997.

In a research note, Lehman analyst Chris Will said recent better-than-expected results from Porshe showed an abrupt turnaround in its profitability and that the subcontract of Boxster manufacture freed up production capacity for the more profitable 996 model.
"The equity market is finally beginning to believe that Porsche is turning more profitable than at any time in its history," Will said.
He repeated a "buy" rating on the stock.
